newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-IVANOV VOTED BULGARIA FOOTBALLER OF THE YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IVANOV VOTED BULGARIA FOOTBALLER OF THE YEAR.

text.p: Trifon Ivanov, Rapid Vienna's star defender, has been voted Bulgarian Footballer of the year.
Ivanov, who is in Sofia for the Christmas holidays, received the award at a ceremony on Thursday. He was elected by Bulgarian soccer journalists and won a Fiat car.

Stuttgart playmaker Krasimir Balakov and Barcelona striker Hristo Stoichkov were runners up for the award. Ivanov captained the Bulgarian team for the first time in their World Cup qualifier against Cyprus on December 14.
